Every week we get a support ticket that starts the same way: "I installed three booking apps and none of them worked right." Nine times out of ten, the merchant skipped one filter on the Shopify App Store: Built for Shopify. That single badge would have saved them a week of testing broken widgets and migrating bookings twice.

This list only includes booking apps that carry the Built for Shopify badge right now, verified directly on their Shopify App Store listings in September 2026. That rule knocks out some well known names, including BookThatApp, which has been a solid choice for rental businesses since 2010 but has never earned the certification. If an app isn't on this list, it's either not certified, or it didn't have enough reviews behind it to evaluate fairly.

Five apps qualified.

What does the Built for Shopify badge actually mean?

Built for Shopify is Shopify's own quality certification, not a marketing claim from the app developer. To earn it, an app has to pass Shopify's review on three fronts: performance (it can't slow your storefront down by more than 10 points), design (it follows Shopify's admin standards), and integration (it uses Shopify's current technology, not a legacy workaround).

That matters more for booking apps than for most other app categories. A booking widget has to check real-time availability, block double bookings, and sync a calendar, all before a customer finishes loading your product page. An app that drags your storefront down doesn't just look bad. It costs you bookings from customers who give up and close the tab.

Shopify doesn't hand this out for free. Apps apply for it, and Shopify tests the app's real impact on a live store before granting it. That's different from a star rating, which measures how happy merchants are after they've already installed the thing. Built for Shopify measures whether the app is technically sound before you ever click install.

How we picked these 5 apps

We started from every booking app we track for Cowlendar's own competitive research, cross-checked each one against its live Shopify App Store listing for the badge, and kept only the apps with a substantial review history behind them. That process is what got us to five: Cowlendar, Apntly, Appointo, BookX, and Easy Appointment Booking App.

Cowlendar built this list. We're not pretending otherwise. But we didn't invent the badge or the review counts, and every one of these apps earned its spot on merit, not because we needed a rival to look weak. Two more apps, Sesami and Tipo, also carry the badge but have fewer reviews than the five featured here, so we cover them briefly in the FAQ instead.

The 5 Built for Shopify booking apps in 2026

1. Cowlendar: the most reviewed, and every feature on every plan

Cowlendar holds 4.9 stars across 2,212 reviews from 22,500+ stores in 85+ countries, the largest verified review base of any Shopify booking app in this category. It's Built for Shopify certified and covers all 8 booking types: one-to-one, group with capacity limits, multiday Airbnb-style, bundles, subscriptions, court sports, restaurant tables, and virtual meetings through Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meet.

The part that actually matters for your budget: every feature is on the free plan. Google Calendar and Outlook two-way sync, WhatsApp reminders, deposits, staff management, Shopify POS. You don't pay extra to get a feature working. You pay when your booking volume outgrows your plan, starting at $13.99/month for up to $1,000 in booking revenue.

Where Cowlendar isn't the answer: we don't have a native customer login portal, and we don't support Reserve with Google directly. We connect through Google Business Profile instead, which gets customers to your booking widget from Google Search but isn't the same integration. If your business needs a dedicated account area for repeat customers to log into, check that before you commit.

2. Apntly: the simplest setup, the highest star count

Apntly holds a perfect 5.0 stars across 1,595 reviews, the highest rating of any app on this list. It's Built for Shopify certified and built around a straightforward premise: turn any product into a bookable service in three steps.

That simplicity is the real advantage. If you've tried a booking app before and gave up because the setup felt like configuring a spreadsheet, Apntly strips away almost everything except the calendar and the booking form. The tradeoff is booking type coverage. Apntly doesn't do multiday reservations, event calendars, tracking pixels, Klaviyo, or WhatsApp reminders, so a rental business or a multi-location salon will hit its ceiling faster than with Cowlendar.

3. Appointo: built for recurring and subscription bookings

Appointo carries 800+ reviews at 4.8 stars and is Built for Shopify certified. Its real strength is one specific use case: subscription and recurring appointments, the kind of booking where a customer commits to a weekly or monthly slot instead of booking one-off. It pairs that with SMS and WhatsApp reminders and Klaviyo integration for follow-up campaigns.

If you run a therapy practice, a coaching business, or a recurring cleaning service, Appointo's waitlist and recurring booking logic is purpose-built for exactly that pattern. For a full side by side on pricing and feature gates, Cowlendar vs Appointo covers where the two apps overlap and where they don't. Multiday reservations and more complex multi-staff scheduling sit behind Appointo's higher tiers, so a hotel or car rental business will find Cowlendar's flat, all-features-included model a better fit.

4. BookX: the universal booking button

BookX, built by Logbase, holds 603 reviews at 5.0 stars and carries the Built for Shopify badge. The standout feature here is the Universal Booking Button: instead of building a separate product page for every bookable service, you can drop a "Book Now" button on your homepage, a blog post, or any landing page and skip the product-to-cart flow entirely.

That's a genuinely useful shortcut for merchants who sell services through content rather than a traditional product catalog. Some reviewers note the interface takes more getting used to than the other apps on this list, so budget extra setup time if your team isn't deeply technical.

5. Easy Appointment Booking App: strongest for events, tours, and tastings

Built by Servicify and holding 537 reviews at 4.9 stars, Easy Appointment Booking App is Built for Shopify certified and leans hardest into events: tours, tastings, workshops, and group sessions with QR ticket check-in built in.

If your booking business looks more like an experience (a wine tasting, a walking tour, a pottery class) than a one-on-one appointment, the QR ticketing and multi-location scheduling here are built specifically for that. It connects to Google Calendar, Outlook, Zoom, and Klaviyo, which covers most of what an events business needs. Staff and multi-location management require a paid tier, so a solo operator running a single class won't need to pay to get started, but a business running events across several venues will hit that wall on the free plan.

Why isn't BookThatApp on this list?

BookThatApp doesn't carry the Built for Shopify badge, which is the only filter this list applies. That doesn't mean it's a bad app. It's been around since 2010, handles rentals and tours well, and holds around 500 reviews at 4.7 stars. But it hasn't gone through Shopify's certification, and it's worth reading its recent checkout complaints before you install it regardless of the badge question. If certification matters to you as a baseline trust signal, that's a reasonable dealbreaker. If it doesn't, Cowlendar vs BookThatApp breaks down the feature and pricing gap in detail.

Which one should you actually install?

If you want the broadest booking type coverage with nothing locked behind a paywall, start with Cowlendar's free plan. If you want the simplest possible setup and only need basic one-to-one appointments, Apntly's three-step flow is hard to beat. If your business runs on recurring bookings, Appointo is purpose-built for that. If you sell services through content and want a booking button that lives outside a product page, BookX's Universal Booking Button solves that specific problem. If you run tours or tastings with in-person check-in, Easy Appointment Booking App's QR tickets are worth a look.

For a broader comparison that includes apps without the certification, our full list of the best Shopify appointment booking apps in 2026 covers additional apps, both certified and not. And if budget is the only variable that matters right now, our roundup of free Shopify booking apps filters specifically for what you can run without a credit card.

FAQ

What does the Built for Shopify badge mean?

It's Shopify's highest certification for third-party apps. To earn it, an app has to pass Shopify's own testing on performance (it can't slow your storefront by more than 10 points), design (it follows Shopify's admin standards), and integration (it uses Shopify's current technology stack). Shopify grants it after direct testing, not based on merchant reviews alone.

How many booking apps have the Built for Shopify badge?

As of September 2026, five booking apps with a substantial review history carry the badge: Cowlendar, Apntly, Appointo, BookX, and Easy Appointment Booking App. Sesami and Tipo also hold the certification but have fewer reviews than the five featured here. Newer apps without an established review base may be certified too but are harder to evaluate for reliability.

Is BookThatApp Built for Shopify certified?

No. BookThatApp has been on the Shopify App Store since 2010 and holds around 500 reviews at 4.7 stars, but it has not earned Built for Shopify certification. That doesn't disqualify it as a tool, but it means it hasn't passed Shopify's own performance and integration review the way the five apps in this list have.

Does a Built for Shopify badge guarantee an app is the best fit for my store?

No. The badge confirms an app meets Shopify's technical bar for speed, design, and integration. It doesn't tell you whether the app covers the specific booking type your business needs, whether its pricing model fits your volume, or whether its feature set matches your workflow. Use the badge as a trust filter, then compare features against your actual use case.

Can I filter the Shopify App Store by the Built for Shopify badge?

Yes. Browse or search a category on the Shopify App Store, then use the Built for Shopify filter option to show only certified apps. You can also ask Shopify's Sidekick assistant directly for Built for Shopify recommendations in your category.
